prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1447; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a collision that occurred in a parking lot. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. Any statements or requests for information from our client should be referred to us.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage limits of every policy that may apply to the insured driver and vehicle involved in this incident, including any excess or umbrella coverage. Please confirm the policy number, the policy period, and the coverage limits in writing.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes claim files, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle and telematics data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, surveillance footage, and any other documents or electronic records in your possession or control. Destruction or alteration of such material could seriously prejudice our client's claim.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
